title: Important lecture-note examples
guidance: Start with the important worked examples in the lecture notes. Cover the shown solution, re-solve each example yourself, and explain why each equation and step is used.

title: T-type tutorial questions
guidance: Attempt the relevant T-type questions after the lecture examples. Use tutorial guidance where needed, but write and justify each step yourself.

title: H-type independent questions
guidance: Attempt the relevant H-type questions independently. Do not open a worked solution or support video until you have made a serious attempt and identified the exact step causing difficulty.

title: Step by Step with Mehdi
guidance: Use the relevant Step by Step with Mehdi PDF when a method or transition is unclear. Pause at each decision, predict the next step, then return to the lecture, T-type, or H-type problem.

title: Interactive exercise app
guidance: Use the matching interactive exercise to check a concept, equation choice, sign convention, or common misconception. Then return to solving the main problem independently.

title: Solutions in Action with Mehdi
guidance: Use the relevant Solutions in Action with Mehdi video after attempting the problem. Pause before each major step, compare the demonstrated reasoning with your own approach, and note the specific correction needed.

title: QuickGuide
guidance: Use the QuickGuide for a concise overview of key concepts, formulas, diagrams, and decision rules. It supports preparation and review but does not replace solving examples and questions.

title: Exit check
guidance: Check whether you can select the correct method and complete the main steps without prompts. Revisit the relevant core problem if an essential step is still unclear.
